falsifier: the HH operands are decoded as code (PC advances only 1 or 3)
alternative: operand bytes 52 00 execute: a Return with 4 on top, result 4 instead of 9
note: 0x06 row: 'PC+=5 (the HH operands are skipped, never read)'. The first H is 0x0052, i.e. bytes 52 00: a Return if it were executed. With PC+=5 the Pop removes the 4 and Return gives 9.
